## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-cards-mill`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-cards-mill -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `card-root-2026-10-12.json`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:
